alternatives_rejected.candidate: checkoutservice: slow only because it waits on emailservice
alternatives_rejected.why: This is the downstream effect, not a separate root cause. checkoutservice p90 rose about 106%, while emailservice p90 rose about 4499% (E1), and callers see emailservice latency jump 57.79x (E2).

alternatives_rejected.candidate: checkoutservice: its own fault, with emailservice affected secondarily
alternatives_rejected.why: emailservice's deviation is roughly 40x larger than checkoutservice's (E1). The caller-observed slowdown is localized to calls into emailservice (E2), so checkoutservice is not the origin.
emailservice's own span self-time is unchanged (0.19->0.19ms, E2). Only the inbound, caller-observed latency rose, which points to network-level delay rather than in-process saturation.

proposed_fix.description: Remove the injected network delay on the emailservice pod or interface (for example, clear the tc netem qdisc or the chaos delay rule). Then verify that checkoutservice-to-emailservice call latency returns to baseline of about 3.5ms p50.
